name: update_ticket_record
description: Finalizes the ticket record after intake workflow completes. Sets status, stamps assigned owner and resolution data, logs operation.

#input_type_name: UpdateTicketRecordInput
#output_type_name: UpdateTicketRecordOutput

from typing import Optional
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from lemma_sdk import FunctionContext, Pod


class UpdateTicketRecordInput(BaseModel):
    ticket_id: str = Field(description="The ticket UUID to update.")
    status: str = Field(description="New status for the ticket.")
    approved_to_send: Optional[bool] = Field(default=None, description="Approval flag.")
    assigned_to: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Owner assigned by human reviewer.")
    human_notes: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Notes from human approval step.")
    resolution_summary: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Recommended resolution.")
    resolution_reasoning: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Full reasoning from advisor.")
    analysis_status: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Analysis status for audit trail.")


class UpdateTicketRecordOutput(BaseModel):
    status: str = Field(description="Operation result: success, not_found, or error.")
    ticket_id: str = Field(description="Echoed ticket_id for workflow tracking.")
    error: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Error detail if update failed.")


async def update_ticket_record(ctx: FunctionContext, data: UpdateTicketRecordInput) -> UpdateTicketRecordOutput:
    pod = Pod.from_env()

    ticket = pod.records.get("tickets", data.ticket_id)
    if not ticket:
        return UpdateTicketRecordOutput(
            status="not_found",
            ticket_id=data.ticket_id,
            error=f"Ticket {data.ticket_id} not found",
        )

    updates = {"status": data.status}
    if data.approved_to_send is not None:
        updates["approved_to_send"] = data.approved_to_send
    if data.assigned_to:
        updates["owner"] = data.assigned_to
    if data.human_notes:
        updates["human_notes"] = data.human_notes
    if data.resolution_summary:
        updates["draft_reply"] = data.resolution_summary

    pod.records.update("tickets", data.ticket_id, updates)

    pod.records.create("operations_log", {
        "action": "ticket_intake_workflow_complete",
        "result": f"status={data.status}, assigned_to={data.assigned_to or 'unassigned'}",
        "actor": "workflow:ticket_intake_workflow",
    })

    return UpdateTicketRecordOutput(
        status="success",
        ticket_id=data.ticket_id,
    )
